# load
as release load release/release.json schema/release.schema.json
load unnamed/unnamed.json schema/release.schema.json
load broken/broken.json schema/release.schema.json
load missing/missing.json schema/release.schema.json
load release/release.json missing/missing.schema.json

# dump
dump @release
dump-silt @release
dump-toml @release
dump-json @release
dump-json --sort @release
as none obj
dump-json @none
as empty arr
dump-json @empty
as text str a "quoted" word
dump-json @text
as assets get @release .assets
dump-json @assets

# pick and without
as safe without @release token
dump-json @safe
as two pick @release name draft missing
dump-json @two
as all without @release
equals @release $all
pick @release
pick @empty name
without @text token
